dimensions.detail: The capabilities are broad and include publishing, scheduling, deleting X posts, uploading media, analytics reads, AI generation, evergreen reposting, and DM outreach, but these match the stated social-posting purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The runtime instructions include concrete API endpoints, account selection guidance, response validation, confirmation before publishing, batch-operation review, and human approval before DM lead sending.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a non-executable markdown skill requiring only OPENTWEET_API_KEY; static scan and VirusTotal telemetry were clean.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network calls to opentweet.io and use of the OpenTweet API key are proportionate to the skill's stated purpose; no unrelated local file access or hidden command execution is present.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: OpenTweet-side persistence is expected for drafts, schedules, uploaded/generated media, evergreen queues, analytics profiles, and DM campaigns; the skill discloses these workflows but does not provide a detailed retention notice.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad posting and outreach scope is real, but it is the core advertised function and the artifact adds confirmation and review guardrails for publishing, bulk actions, and DM approvals.
[SQP-2] expected: Sending content, media, account metadata, analytics, and outreach data to OpenTweet is expected for this API integration, though users should understand the third-party processing and storage implications before use.
llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable giving OpenTweet API access to manage the connected X account. Review posts, articles, evergreen settings, and DM leads before approving actions, and be aware that uploaded/generated media, drafts, schedules, analytics, and campaign data may be stored or processed by OpenTweet.
llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed OpenTweet integration for managing X posts, media, analytics, articles, evergreen queues, and human-approved DM outreach through the user's API key.
